title: CT auth canonical contract (LINKAGE source for SCP-R-010 + SCP-R-011)
description: Shape of control-tower's contracts/auth-contract-v1.yaml as SCP-R-010 (auth-canonical-import-fence) + SCP-R-011 (auth-contract-claim-shape) read it. LINKAGE-not-VALUES (D-049/D-058): SCP validates the SHAPE it depends on (claim_shape_version, the issuers list, the two-tier protected_primitives symbol sets) and TOLERATES additional CT-authored fields (additionalProperties:true) — CT is the sole auth canonical authority. The contract is fetched + cosign-verified via the sibling auth-contract-v1.yaml.sig.bundle (the REAL verification anchor; keyless Sigstore OIDC, identity .../control-tower/.github/workflows/contract-manifest-publish.yml@refs/heads/main) by the materialisation workflow; SCP never copies issuer/symbol values into rule bodies. Verified against the live contract 2026-06-06 (claim_shape_version 2.0.0).

as_of.description: Publish timestamp; refreshed by CT's contract-manifest-publish.yml cron.

claim_shape_version.description: Current JWT claim-shape contract version (live 2.0.0; MAJOR bump per CT ASC-2026-05-30-002). SCP-R-011 gates adopter Claims types against this.

issuers.description: Canonical issuer set. SCP-R-011 checks an adopter's hardcoded issuer strings are members of this set's iss values (no canonical_issuer_pattern regex field exists; issuers are enumerated).

audience.description: Per-issuer audience; a single string OR an array of strings.

protected_primitives.description: Two severity tiers. A shadowed/re-implemented tier_deny symbol is a security hole (SCP-R-010 deny); a shadowed tier_warn symbol is correctness drift (SCP-R-010 warn).
